title: Jamal: couch-surfing, no income, likely about $306 and 3-day service likely; interview missed
about: Demo case. seed=true: created by POST /api/demo/seed; every case can also be created by POST /api/demo/inject. Build a Case (seeded, live false, persona and code as given, created minutes_ago before now, ended_reason as given), set each slot from `slots` with state clear, source seed, heard / heard_en / turn from the maps below and confirmed for the listed slots; copy the `asked` entries as given when the file has them (AskedQuestion, in order; `turn` = the student turn whose reply asked the question; never a second entry for a key already listed); run the rules, create the card, then apply status (and tracking dates). Every time and date is relative to the seed time (now) in America/Los_Angeles and never falls before not_before, the first morning of the FY2027 table: a computed time earlier than not_before is raised to it, but never later than now (created_at = min(now, max(now - minutes_ago, not_before)); reviewed_at and tracking dates likewise), and the order created_at <= tracking dates <= reviewed_at <= now is kept. `expect` is what the rules must produce for this case.

tracking.note: Filed 3 days before the seed day; the county's interview call was missed the day before the seed day. Dates are the seed day in America/Los_Angeles minus these days, raised to the not_before day (2026-10-01) when earlier: applied_on = max(seed day - applied_days_ago, 2026-10-01); the interview is on max(seed day - interview_days_ago, applied_on) at interview_local_time, never later than the seed time. Seeded on Fri 2026-10-02: applied Thu Oct 1, interview Thu Oct 1 at 10:00 (missed); from Sun Oct 4 on the dates are exactly 3 days and 1 day back.

program_answers_note: Card answers seeded with the case (ProgramAnswer source 'seed'; at = created_at + call_seconds, never later than now; the file stores choice ids only, and the seed builds each ProgramAnswer from them), so the seeded case list shows 'Found about $3,980/yr'. They are never asked on the call and never change a CalFresh slot or the estimate. pge_bill is not asked (Jamal is homeless). Maria's and Sofia's demo cases have no seeded answers: the judge taps them on the card.

programs.hand_calc: CalFresh 306 x 12 = 3,672. Clipper START, 1-2 days a week = 4 rides: full fare min(4 x 2.85 = 11.40, 86 x 12 / 52 = 19.846) = 11.40; START min(4 x 1.40 = 5.60, 43 x 12 / 52 = 9.923) = 5.60; (11.40 - 5.60) x 17 break weeks = 98.60 -> 98. California LifeLine 19 x 12 = 228 (a ceiling). Found 3,672 + 98 + 228 = 3,998; display 3,670 + 90 + 220 = 3,980; share 3,900. Medi-Cal: coverage (no income, at or under the 138% line); CARE hidden (homeless, no PG&E question); tax credits hidden (no earnings). Apply-by on 2026-10-02: the first break gap (2026-12-19) minus 30 mail days = 2026-11-19.
